prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported whiplash. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1039; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane on a multi-lane road in Conroe, Texas, when Driver 2 changed lanes from the right and struck the left side of Driver 1's vehicle along its rear quarter panel. Both drivers stopped at the roadside and exchanged information. Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash and said the impact jolted their head forward and back. A Passenger was also seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the collision, and both the responding officer and a nearby witness confirmed that the Passenger was present. Driver 2 acknowledged changing lanes without checking the blind spot and gave an account matching Driver 1's description of how the crash occurred. Two independent witnesses and photographs taken at the scene corroborate the sequence of events. The damage visible on Driver 1's vehicle lines up with a sideswipe of this type, and the officer observed no prior damage to the vehicle's left side. Driver 1 is listed as the named driver on the insurance policy for the vehicle. Medical attention was offered at the scene and Driver 1 agreed to be transported for evaluation.
